turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Monday starting off? Are you feeling completely back to 100% after that flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! Yes, I'm feeling totally back to normal, thank goodness. My morning started off pretty quiet. I just made a simple pot of filtered brewed coffee in my kitchen machine today, keeping it low-key.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, sometimes a classic cup of brewed coffee is exactly what you need, even with your roommate's new espresso machine right there! Did you have an easy trip into the clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was pretty smooth! I rode the valley's public commuter train line to get to work this morning.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice, the train is a great way to avoid any traffic. How has your day-shift at the outpatient clinic been going since you got in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's been quite busy with patients today, but I'm just about wrapping up my shift now. It's nice to be back in the groove of things.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! You deserve a relaxing evening. Do you have any plans tonight, maybe catching up with Tom or doing some salsa dancing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am actually meeting up with Tom tonight! We're just going to hang out and relax. No salsa dancing tonight, but I might feed my sourdough starter when I get home later.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect, cozy Monday evening. How is your starter doing lately? Have you baked anything with it recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's doing really well! I haven't baked a loaf in a few days, but the cooler Phoenix winter weather actually makes it a bit easier to manage the fermentation speed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's true, December in Phoenix must be much more pleasant for baking compared to the summer heat! I hope you have a wonderful evening relaxing with Tom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks so much! I'm looking forward to it. I'll talk to you tomorrow!
